summary: Bug hunt on all five live channels. Two Scorecard fixes: the on-target ring now stays beside its reading on a phone, and last week no longer reads 'no Shorts' when its Shorts are only waiting for numbers.
why: Code review of the Scorecard page (never reviewed before) found two bugs the owner sees daily. Each fix has a smoke test that failed before and passes after. tsc, lint and build pass; smoke tests 127 passed, 5 skipped.

findings.title: Scorecard ring alone on a phone
findings.detail: The verdict row stacked below 640 px. The ring took a row by itself, and the Shorts count began with a stray '·'.

findings.title: Scorecard said 'no Shorts last week' wrongly
findings.detail: It showed this when last week had Shorts that were still waiting for YouTube's numbers.

changes.title: Scorecard: ring beside its reading on a phone
changes.detail: The ring and the on-target reading share a row at every width; the separator dot shows only on wider screens.

changes.title: Scorecard: last week's Shorts still waiting
changes.detail: It says "last week's still waiting" when last week had Shorts without numbers yet.
